Definition: record identifier in the source sleep database export
Note: unique within the export; not stable across the three sex files

Definition: which of the three exports the record came from (Female / Male / Mixed)
Note: added by the build script; equals the registry Item number suffix

Definition: sex class as printed (F / M / Mix)
Land or Marine as classified in the source
Note: drives which of the in-water / on-land columns are populated

Definition: short citation of the primary sleep study
Note: Capellini compiled these; each row's real measurer is this reference

Definition: full citation of the primary sleep study
species name exactly as printed in the source export
Note: printed name preserved verbatim (invariant 3); printed in Title Case

Definition: common name as printed
Note: the only species clue for the one record whose species column is N/A

Definition: accepted scientific binomial resolved via _keys/Stephan/species_key.csv (source_publication = Capellini2008)
Note: 93 species; NA for the one unidentified record; Fur Seal and Tapir stay as printed pending curator review

Definition: total daily sleep time as reported
Note: project standardized term; hours per day as printed - no unit conversion

Definition: total daily sleep adjusted for drowsiness
Note: populated for very few records; alternative to Sleep_h_day - do not average the two

Definition: paradoxical (REM) sleep time as reported
Note: PS = paradoxical sleep = REM; used to derive REM_sleep_pct

Definition: quiet (NREM / slow-wave) sleep time as reported
Note: carried for completeness; not currently a merged term

Definition: length of one sleep cycle
Note: minutes as printed; sparsely populated (57 of 183 records)

Definition: per cent of total sleep spent in REM
Note: project standardized term; = 100 * REM_h / Sleep_h_day

Definition: total daily sleep recorded in water
Note: marine records only

Definition: total daily sleep recorded on land
Note: marine records only

Definition: REM sleep recorded in water
Note: marine records only

Definition: REM sleep recorded on land
Note: marine records only

Definition: quiet sleep recorded in water
Note: marine records only

Definition: quiet sleep recorded on land
Note: marine records only

Definition: unihemispheric slow-wave sleep as reported by the primary study

Definition: bihemispheric slow-wave sleep as reported

Definition: asymmetric slow-wave sleep as reported

number of animals contributing to the calculated mean

whether sleep was scored from EEG

whether the recording covered a full 24 h

whether animals were adapted to the recording setup
feeding condition during recording

whether animals were restrained
whether sleep was scored behaviourally

monophasic or polyphasic sleep pattern

Definition: whether the primary study post-dates Elgar et al. 1988
